findings: Generic policy header/source contain no Q4K, EXEC148, Split-K32, P1/P3, W-S/W-C, family residency constant, or first-family numeric-ID literals.
Runtime state is keyed by opaque PrimitiveId and AcquisitionPathId rather than family-specific fields.
Selection consumes registry capability/profile/evidence state, resident preference, lifecycle, acquisition priority and threshold metadata.
Only VALIDATED descriptors participate in active decisions.
CAPABILITY_GATED and DISABLED_BY_EVIDENCE paths remain knowledge but are not selectable.

reference_equivalence.threshold_rule: All nonzero thresholds emitted by frozen B1 are preserved exactly.
reference_equivalence.diagnostic_normalization: Legacy tertiary below-threshold fallthrough emitted threshold 0; generic policy reports the registry-derived tertiary threshold while preserving fallback/no-acquisition.

proved: Independent opaque family is selected by the same engine with no engine source change.
CAPABILITY_GATED and DISABLED_BY_EVIDENCE paths are ignored even when runtime marks them available.
A threshold-satisfied lower-priority path can win when a higher-priority active path has not met its threshold.
When multiple active paths meet thresholds, lowest numeric priority wins.
Resident hysteresis, outside-domain preservation, execution-unavailable eviction, model-unload eviction, lease-revoke eviction and zero-reuse eviction are registry driven.

output: NO MODEL LOAD. NO GPU. NO VULKAN. NO TIMING. NO PLACEMENT BENCHMARK.
portable_native_zero_science.provenance_boundary: GitHub-hosted exact-byte native build did not execute because no runner was allocated. Exact committed blobs passed static audit. Portable native compilation exercised the same policy semantics but is not represented as a GitHub exact-byte build.
